Title: Horizontal BOLA PHI data leak on patient listing endpoint
Steps to Reproduce: 1. Log in as patient role. 2. Send GET /api/v1/patients with Bearer token.
Expected Result: HTTP 403 Forbidden or return only own patient record
Actual Result: HTTP 200 OK returning array of all patients in hospital database with full PHI
Proposed Fix: Check req.user.role === 'patient'; if true return only own record

Title: MongoDB duplicate key collision returns 500 instead of 409
Steps to Reproduce: 1. Attempt to register two users with identical email or duplicate resource ID.
Actual Result: HTTP 500 Internal Server Error with unhandled stack trace

Title: Rate limiter memory store leaks across test suites causing test failures
Steps to Reproduce: 1. Run full Jest test suite across all 22 suites in one command.
Actual Result: Rate limiter hits >100 reqs from 127.0.0.1; returns 429 to auth endpoints causing test fails
Proposed Fix: Mock rateLimiter in integration suites and isolate in-memory store

Title: Multi-item prescription dispensing lacks transaction rollback on partial stockout
Steps to Reproduce: 1. Create prescription with Drug A (10 in stock) and Drug B (0 in stock). 2. Call PATCH /prescriptions/:id/dispense.
Expected Result: Prescription rejected; Drug A stock remains untouched at 10 units
Actual Result: Drug A stock decremented to 0; Drug B throws 400; prescription remains active with leaked stock
Proposed Fix: Pre-flight check stock for all items before decrementing; record StockMovement

Title: Revenue aggregation double-counts total invoice value for partial payments
Steps to Reproduce: 1. Create invoice for 10000. 2. Record 1000 payment. 3. Call GET /api/v1/analytics/revenue.
Actual Result: Revenue aggregates 10000 from total and 9000 from balance reporting 19000 total value
Proposed Fix: Aggregate paidAmount or (total - balance) for partial status instead of summing total

Title: Frontend has zero automated tests causing test script exit 1
Steps to Reproduce: 1. Run cd frontend && npm run test -- --run.
Expected Result: Test suite executes component tests and passes with coverage report
Actual Result: Vitest exits with code 1 and error 'No test files found'
Proposed Fix: Created Vitest suites for format, authSlice, brand/utils

Title: Doctor consultation fee does not auto-populate on invoice creation
Steps to Reproduce: 1. Create invoice providing appointmentId with empty lineItems.
Expected Result: Line item automatically populated with Doctor consultationFee
Actual Result: Throws 400 validation error 'Invoice must have at least one line item'
Proposed Fix: Auto-populate Doctor consultationFee line item when lineItems omitted

Title: Pharmacy dispensing does not log StockMovement audit records
Steps to Reproduce: 1. Dispense a prescription. 2. Check StockMovement collection in database.
Expected Result: StockMovement document created recording deduction quantity and prescription reference
Actual Result: Zero records created in StockMovement collection

Title: Overdue invoice promotion never runs automatically
Steps to Reproduce: 1. Issue an invoice with dueDate in the past. 2. Check status after due date.
Expected Result: Invoice automatically marked overdue by background scheduler
Actual Result: Invoice remains in status 'issued' until someone manually calls .save()
Proposed Fix: Added daily midnight node-cron job promoting expired issued invoices to overdue

Title: Multi-tenancy completely absent despite explicit SRS requirement

Expected Result: Every model contains tenantId field with tenant-scoped query filters
Actual Result: Zero tenantId fields exist anywhere in backend models or tokens
Proposed Fix: Formally descoped per user directive; single-hospital enterprise architecture confirmed
